summary: Iteration 5 (backend only) — re-tested the recipe-generator quota bug from iteration 4. The fix in /app/backend/server.py:480-489 (used_today() now aggregates db.ai_recipes for the current day alongside pairings + menus + chat_messages) is CORRECT and verified. New file /app/backend/tests/test_pairly_iter5_quota.py has 9 tests, ALL PASSING (9/9): (1) /api/usage returns proper {used_today, limit, remaining, is_premium} shape for a fresh free user; (2) POST /api/pairings still returns 200 and hydrated response with iter4 extended fields (flavor_profile/nutrition_notes/alternatives per item) and used_today ticks to 1; (3) GET /api/feed returns hydrated posts with author card + like_count/comment_count; (4) 5 seeded ai_recipes docs → /api/usage.used_today == 5, remaining == 0 (proves aggregation); (5) 5 seeded chat_messages today → POST /api/recipes/generate returns 402; (6) 5 seeded chat_messages today → POST /api/pairings returns 402; (7) mixed 2 chat + 2 pairings + 1 ai_recipe = 5 → both endpoints return 402; (8) premium user (is_premium=True) with 5 chats today still gets 200 on POST /api/pairings (unlimited); (9) real LLM POST /api/recipes/generate (~24s) increments used_today by exactly 1. Also re-ran the iteration 4 TestRecipeGenerator class — both tests including the previously-red test_generate_recipe_ok (which asserts used_today >= 1 after recipe generation) now PASS. Bug is confirmed fixed. No new backend issues found.

critical_code_review_comments: used_today() at server.py:480-489 now correctly counts db.ai_recipes for the current day — matches the spec (pairing + menu + chat_message + generated recipe all count toward the 5/day cap).

The hard-coded list of quota-consuming collections is still a regression hazard: any new AI endpoint that writes to a new collection will silently be free unless a maintainer remembers to update used_today(). A central 'ai_events' collection or a decorator stamping ai_event=true on every quota-consuming insert would eliminate this class of bug entirely.
